events.title: Cayucos Farmers Market
events.window: Every Friday, 10am–12:30pm, Memorial Day through Labor Day
events.venue: Corner of D Street & Ocean Avenue, Cayucos
events.summary: Weekly open-air market with local produce, fish, baked goods, plants & flowers. Runs through Labor Day weekend.

events.title: ECOSLO Creeks to Coast Cleanup — Cayucos Beach
events.organizer: ECOSLO (Environmental Center of San Luis Obispo)
events.summary: Free volunteer beach cleanup at Cayucos Pier, part of CA Coastal Cleanup Day. Gloves & supplies provided. 9am–noon.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.venue: N. Ocean Avenue & Cayucos Drive, Downtown Cayucos
events.summary: Classic cars fill downtown Cayucos 8am–4pm. Live band, beer garden, Lions BBQ lunch. Friday night check-in party at Nelson's Garage.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos — Tree Lighting & Open House
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce & Cayucos Lioness Club
events.summary: Annual holiday tree lighting with carolers, Santa & Mrs. Claus, carriage rides & merchant open house. Exact Dec 2026 date TBC.
